# FlareDocumentTabs

`Flare.Components.IDE.FlareDocumentTabs`

Displays document tabs with optional controlled selection, ordering and retained panels.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Kind | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ActiveKey` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Active document key. Null starts with the first document and permits internal selection; with ControlledSelection set, null means no active tab and the value is authoritative. |
| `ActiveKeyChanged` | `EventCallback<string>` | `` | Callback |  | Reports the selected document's key. |
| `ChildContent` | `RenderFragment?` | `` | Parameter |  | Declares the document tabs, using a Blazor key for each dynamically rendered document. |
| `ContextMenuContent` | `RenderFragment<string>?` | `` | Parameter |  | Context menu entries rendered for the given document key. |
| `ControlledSelection` | `bool` | `false` | Parameter |  | Whether ActiveKey is the only source of the selection. When true, null means no document is active and a click or navigation key only reports the key through ActiveKeyChanged - the host selects it by setting ActiveKey. A key that matches no declared document also leaves every tab inactive. The default false keeps the uncontrolled behavior: null starts with the first document and clicks select internally. |
| `DockTargets` | `IReadOnlyList<FlareDocumentDockTarget>?` | `` | Parameter |  | Destinations offered in each tab's move menu. Set OnDockRequested too; without it no menu is rendered. The strip does not move the document itself - the host updates its document list and layout selection. |
| `Dockable` | `bool` | `false` | Parameter |  | Makes every tab a drag source for FlareIdeLayout docking even when Reorderable is off. Each dockable tab needs an explicit Key; the key is what the layout receives through OnDocumentMove. The host must declare the same key in Documents. |
| `KeepAlive` | `bool` | `false` | Parameter |  | Keeps previously activated panels mounted while hidden. |
| `OnCloseRequested` | `EventCallback<string>` | `` | Callback |  | Reports a request to close the document by key. The host removes its declaration. |
| `OnDockRequested` | `EventCallback<FlareDocumentDockRequest>` | `` | Callback |  | Reports the document key and the destination the user chose in a tab's move menu. |
| `OnTabChanged` | `EventCallback<string>` | `` | Callback |  | Reports the title of the selected document. |
| `OnTabClose` | `EventCallback<string>` | `` | Callback |  | Reports the title of the document requested to close. |
| `OverflowBehavior` | `TabOverflowBehavior` | `TabOverflowBehavior.Scroll` | Parameter |  | How to navigate when the strip overflows. |
| `Reorderable` | `bool` | `false` | Parameter |  | Whether documents can be moved within the strip using drag or Alt+Arrow. |
| `StripOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Parameter |  | Renders only the tab strip and no panel region. The FlareDocumentTab children still declare the documents (key, title, icon, closeable) and stay mounted, but neither their content nor a tabpanel element is rendered - the host renders the document itself, so KeepAlive and each tab's content are ignored in this mode. Use it as CenterDockHeader: the layout then takes the Center selection only from ActiveDocuments, so write the key reported by ActiveKeyChanged into that selection, and return to the main content by setting the Center entry to null. |
| `TabOrder` | `IReadOnlyList<string>?` | `` | Parameter |  | Controlled document key order. Unlisted documents follow in declaration order. |
| `TabOrderChanged` | `EventCallback<IReadOnlyList<string>>` | `` | Callback |  | Reports a requested order containing the keys of the current documents. |
| `AdditionalAttributes` | `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object>?` | `` | Parameter |  | Additional attributes. Inherited from `FlareComponentBase`. |
| `Class` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Additional CSS class(es) appended to the component's root element. Inherited from `FlareComponentBase`. |
| `Style` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Inline style string appended to the component's root element. Inherited from `FlareComponentBase`. |
